messages:
Sam (People Ops): quick sync 90-min onboarding kickoff for Remi next Mon. drafting a compact manager + HR checklist here. pls call dibs on owners. :wave:

Lina (IT): i'll take laptop imaging + MDM enrollment. will need shipping address if remote. expect done by Fri if asset assigned.

Carlos (Hiring Manager): i'll handle day-1 1:1 and the 30/60/90 draft. also will prepare a 1-page 'what success looks like in 90 days' doc.

Devon (Engineering): can we do early GitHub org invite and CI/CD read-only creds on day 1? also pair Remi with an eng buddy for first-week pairing sessions. i'll own buddy pairing.

Sam (People Ops): current checklist (owners in parens):
- Slack + team channel invite (People Ops)
- Email + SSO account (IT)
- Laptop imaged & MDM (IT - Lina)
- VPN cert + MFA setup (IT - Lina)
- GitHub org invite + team perms (Eng - Devon)
- Dev cluster namespace + k8s role (Infra, Devon to follow up)
- Manager 1:1 & role expectations doc (Hiring Manager - Carlos)
- 30/60/90 goal draft (Hiring Manager - Carlos)
- Benefits orientation + payroll setup (OnboardBot)
- Security briefing & code of conduct (People Ops)

Lina (IT): FYI we hit a provisioning race last month. if account created <24h before start it may not propagate SSO groups. workaround: run `okta sync --force email` after account creation.

Devon (Engineering): Infra, can you pre-create namespace `remi-dev` and add `platform-developers`?

OnboardBot: benefits onboarding email sent to remi@example.com. payroll form link included.

InfraOps (via Devon): namespace `remi-dev` created and documented in ticket #9124. granted `edit` to `platform-developers`.

Carlos (Hiring Manager): scheduling: Day 1 10am intro + expectations, Tue 2pm 30/60/90 review. I'll attach the 1-pager and draft goals to the calendar invites.

Sam (People Ops): perfect. one small ask 9— can the manager add 3 concrete first-week tasks so Remi has something to ship? even tiny measurable wins help.

Carlos (Hiring Manager): noted. i'll put 3 tasks in the invite and a short checklist: read architecture overview, set up local dev, run a smoke test on staging.

Lina (IT): reacted :thumbsup:

Devon (Engineering): reacted :thumbsup:

Sam (People Ops): i'll publish this as a compact Notion checklist and ping Remi + team. thanks y'all! :tada:
